question: What exactly are the material specifications for your HDPE invisible grills?
answer: At GCM Netting Solutions in Chennai, our invisible grills are constructed using high-density polyethylene (HDPE) material. This robust plastic is specifically chosen for its exceptional strength, durability, and resistance to environmental factors. Our HDPE netting is UV stabilized, which is crucial in Chennai's sunny climate. This stabilization process prevents degradation from prolonged sun exposure, ensuring the netting remains strong and effective for years to come. The specific tensile strength and mesh size are carefully selected based on the application and load-bearing requirements. This ensures optimal safety and prevents falls. We pride ourselves on sourcing only the highest quality HDPE, which translates to enhanced longevity and performance of our invisible grills. Our professional installation team meticulously installs the netting, guaranteeing a secure and aesthetically pleasing solution. As a testament to our confidence in the quality of our materials and workmanship, we offer a warranty of 3-5 years on our invisible grill installations.
